description.text: Tracking alongside at a slow, small-amplitude drift, the shot opens on a snow-covered street rendered in 1990s cel animation, with flat painted color fields and hard ink outlines.

rolls forward from stillness, its carbon fibre body catching broad, simplified highlights while the tyres press fresh dark tracks into the slush. Flakes drift across parked vehicles and low shopfronts; the street stays open around the car as it builds a steady forward pace.
shifts from rest into a steady roll, tyres biting into the packed snow and leaving the first dark tracks behind.
A low engine hum and the crunch of snow rise under the movement as loose flakes drift through the street.
The view pushes in with a slow, small-amplitude move as

sweeps past a heaped snowbank. The carbon fibre panels fill more of the frame, their cel-shaded planes separated by crisp ink lines, while the snowbank slides out of view and the car keeps accelerating along the white street.
sweeps past the heaped snowbank, and broad highlights travel over the carbon fibre panels as the street opens ahead.
Slush sprays softly from the tyres while the engine note stays steady and close.

pulls away down the snowy street, shrinking toward the far corner. Its twin tyre tracks stretch back across the foreground, snowfall thickens into soft cel-painted flecks, and the long empty street becomes the dominant shape as the car grows distant.
draws away toward the far corner, leaving twin tracks across the snow as the street widens around it.
The engine recedes into the distance and wind stirs loose snow across the empty street.
